landing.heroTitle: Turn market noise, trade history and execution mistakes into a clearer trading process.
landing.heroText: SkillEdge AI connects your journal, screenshots, chart review, market intelligence, AI scanner, alerts, reports and learning workflow into one premium trading workspace — without promising profits or replacing your own judgment.
landing.problemTitle: Most traders do not need more noise. They need a cleaner process.
landing.problemText: Charts, screenshots, emotions, watchlists, notes and mistakes often live in different places. SkillEdge AI brings them into one workflow so the trader can review decisions, understand patterns and build a repeatable process.
landing.whyTitle: What SkillEdge AI helps you organize
landing.whyText: The platform is designed around the real trading loop: find what matters, plan the trade, execute with discipline, record the result and learn from the outcome.
landing.heroTitle.2: One connected workspace for trading performance.
landing.heroText.2: SkillEdge AI is built as a premium trading operating system: journal, screenshots, AI Coach, reports, charts, scanner, alerts, playbook and support in one clean workflow.
landing.deskTitle: A trading desk should give context, not blind calls.
landing.deskText: SkillEdge AI is designed to explain why an opportunity matters, what confirms it, what invalidates it and where the risk sits. The goal is better decision-making, not blind dependency.
landing.flowTitle: From market scan to personal improvement — one connected loop.
landing.flowText: Every serious trading idea should become data: what the market showed, what the trader planned, what was executed and what the outcome taught.
landing.modulesTitle: Everything is designed to work together.
landing.modulesText: Each module can be useful alone. Together they create a premium workspace where the trader can discover opportunities, execute with structure and review performance.
landing.differentTitle: This is not another signal service. It is a performance system.
landing.differentText: The best traders do not only search for entries. They build process, risk control, review, discipline and repeatable patterns. SkillEdge AI is being built around that reality.
landing.finalTitle: Build a trading system around your real behavior.
landing.finalText: SkillEdge AI is for traders who are tired of scattered tools, emotional decisions and unclear reviews. The product helps the client see the market cleaner, execute with more structure and understand what to improve next.

landing.storyTitle: SkillEdge AI is built for traders who want discipline, structure and measurable improvement.
landing.storyText: The product was born from the same problem many active traders face: the market gives too much information, but almost no honest feedback about execution. SkillEdge AI is designed to connect the trader’s decisions, screenshots, journal, alerts and outcomes into one serious review system.

landing.roadmapTitle: We are building toward a premium AI Trading Desk.
landing.roadmapText: The launch foundation is product-focused: journal, alerts, learning, reports, support, billing and market intelligence. The next layer is premium data, full market scanning and personal alerts based on the client’s own history.
